dataStoreTool.name: search_available_games
dataStoreTool.description: Search for available casino games based on user preferences, such as theme (e.g., Space, Sweets, Egypt, Ocean, Jungle, Ninja, Vampire, West) or game type (e.g., Slots, Roulette, Bingo).

summarizationConfig.prompt: Based on the user's $query, search the $sources for matching casino games. You are currently in this $conversation. YOU MUST output the raw JSON array of the matching games. Each object MUST include `title`, `short_description`, `url`, and `theme`. Do not add markdown or pleasantries, just the JSON string array. Example: [{"title": "Coral Cash", "short_description": "Play coral slots!", "url": "https://casino.oliviervg.com/game/coral-cash", "theme": "Ocean"}]
